latest.title: Deploying an Email/SMS Spam Classifier on AWS EC2 Using Streamlit
latest.description: I built and deployed an Email/SMS Spam Classifier on AWS EC2 using Streamlit, Scikit-learn, and NLTK. In this article, I share the complete deployment process, the challenges I faced with cloud environments and NLP dependencies, and the key lessons I learned while moving an ML project from local development to AWS.

latest.title: OpenClaw 与 Hermes Agent 单机部署指南 - 开发者实战手记
latest.description: 本文记录了在同一台 Amazon EC2 实例上同时部署 OpenClaw 和 Hermes Agent 两个开源 AI Agent 的完整过程。两者共享同一个 IAM Role 和 Amazon Bedrock 后端模型，各自连接不同的微信账号独立运行。文章涵盖实例升级、Hermes Agent 安装配置、微信接入、常见问题排查（用户授权、上下文压缩、输出截断），以及两个 Agent 在架构、内存占用和功能特性上的详细对比。适合已有 AWS 部署经验、希望探索多 Agent 并行运行方案的开发者参考。

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

A Amazon Web Services (AWS)
